blocks.text:
Free time in Búzios. Explore the beaches, bays and scenic viewpoints by buggy. Diving, surfing, waterskiing, kayaking and boat excursions with swimming stops are available. In the evening, restaurants and shops open along the resort’s pedestrian streets. All additional activities are charged separately.

Instead of Búzios, you can choose Angra dos Reis or northeastern Brazilian resorts for your beach stay: Porto de Galinhas, Pipa, Salvador, Jericoacoara, Aquiraz, Porto Seguro and Trancoso. Flights from Rio to northeastern resorts take around 2–3 hours; any alternative beach stay must be arranged separately.
